title: LLM-based Framework for Generating and Verifying Parallel DEVS Statecharts
abstract: arXiv:2608.14956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The development of models demands sound modeling and simulation knowledge as well as domain knowledge. Every model should accurately represent a system's dynamics and be verifiable. Toward this objective, this research introduces an agentic PDEVS-LLM framework to assist human modelers in generating and verifying PDEVS statecharts for behavior modeling of atomic Parallel Discrete Event System Specification (PDEVS) models. The framework supports (re)generating plausible facts from a system description prompt using the agentic LLM used for generating plausible facts. Inconsistencies in plausible facts lead to incorrect PDEVS statecharts having logical structure and behavioral inaccuracies. A controlled-correction mechanism is developed to verify the logical consistency of the plausible facts. translated_title: 基于LLM的并行DEVS状态图生成与验证框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14956v1 公告类型：新 摘要：模型的开发需要扎实的建模与仿真知识以及领域知识。每个模型都应准确表示系统的动态行为，并且是可验证的。为实现这一目标，本研究引入了一个智能体PDEVS-LLM框架，以协助人类建模者生成和验证用于原子并行离散事件系统规范（PDEVS）模型行为建模的PDEVS状态图。该框架支持使用用于生成合理事实的智能体LLM，从系统描述提示中（重新）生成合理事实。合理事实中的不一致会导致PDEVS状态图出现逻辑结构和行为上的错误。为此，开发了一种受控修正机制来验证合理事实的逻辑一致性。智能体LLM用于从系统描述提示中生成关键行为条件，然后根据这些行为条件对合理事实进行验证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种智能体PDEVS-LLM框架，利用LLM自动生成和验证并行DEVS状态图，并通过受控修正机制确保逻辑一致性，以提高建模准确性和可验证性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an agentic PDEVS-LLM framework that uses LLMs to generate and verify parallel DEVS statecharts, with a controlled-correction mechanism to ensure logical consistency, enhancing modeling accuracy and verifiability.
